findings.title: Embedded topic author link color lightness changed in light theme
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, so the light theme branch changed from 30% to 70% lightness. The first argument should remain `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` (the dark theme branch would then be 70%). As written, the embedded post author link becomes much lighter than intended in light themes.
